privileged_info_for_vlm: The agent must audit three specific sites: Khan Academy (khanacademy.org), Coursera (coursera.org), and MIT OpenCourseWare (ocw.mit.edu). For each site, the report must include: 1) Site Name, 2) URL, 3) Performance Score, 4) Accessibility Score, and 5) A recommendation. The scores must match the values seen in the Lighthouse tool screenshots during the trajectory. The final output must be a .txt file on the Desktop.
